name: adfmd
description: ADF-Markdown converter for JavaScript and TypeScript.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp ../../schemas/adf-schema.json dist/schemas/adf-schema.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/conformance.test.mjs && node --test test/adf-validation.test.mjs test/options.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs
